'''Iona Wince''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]], who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
When Wince was eleven, the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] liner ''[[Starlite Cloud]]'' stopped by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] and she stowed away aboard it. She was discovered by the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], who took a liking to her and put her to work as a steward. The young girl joined the Rebel Alliance and made it easier for Alliance operatives to book passage on the ''Cloud'', by keeping watch for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents. She also listened in on conversations about Imperial actions against the Alliance and could use her steward's pass card to access any part of the ship.
